title: Shipping Configuration
description: Learn how to configure shipping methods, rates, and delivery zones for your Matjrii store.
content:
Shipping Configuration

Shipping configuration is essential for e-commerce. This guide covers setting up shipping methods, rates, and delivery zones in Matjrii.

Accessing Shipping Settings

To configure shipping:

  1. Navigate to Shipping in the sidebar
  2. View all shipping methods
  3. Create or edit shipping methods

Shipping Methods

Matjrii supports various shipping methods:

Flat Rate Shipping

  • Fixed cost for all orders
  • Simple and predictable
  • Good for standard shipping

Free Shipping

  • Conditional free shipping
  • Based on order value
  • Attract customers with free shipping

Weight-Based Shipping

  • Cost calculated by product weight
  • Accurate for varied products
  • Set weight ranges and prices

Distance-Based Shipping

  • Cost based on delivery distance
  • Good for local delivery
  • Configure distance zones

Percentage-Based Shipping

  • Shipping as percentage of order total
  • Scales with order value
  • Simple to configure

Local Pickup

  • Customer picks up from store
  • No shipping cost
  • Specify pickup location

Creating Shipping Methods

To create a shipping method:

  1. Go to Shipping
  2. Click Create Shipping Method
  3. Enter method details:
    • Method name
    • Description
    • Shipping type
    • Rates
    • Delivery zones
  4. Configure settings
  5. Save

Delivery Zones

Configure delivery zones:

Zone Types

  • Domestic: Within your country
  • International: Outside your country
  • Local: Specific city or region
  • Regional: Specific region or state

Country Restrictions

Limit shipping to specific countries:

  • Select allowed countries
  • Exclude specific countries
  • Set default for unlisted countries

Postal Code Targeting

Target specific areas:

  • Include specific postal codes
  • Exclude specific postal codes
  • Set ranges

Shipping Rates

Set shipping rates:

Fixed Rates

  • Same price for all orders
  • Simple pricing

Conditional Rates

  • Based on order value
  • Based on weight
  • Based on distance

Free Shipping Threshold

Offer free shipping:

  • Set minimum order value
  • Apply to specific zones
  • Create promotional shipping

Handling Fees

Add handling fees:

  • Fixed handling fee
  • Percentage of order
  • Per item fee

Estimated Delivery Time

Set delivery estimates:

  • Business days
  • Calendar days
  • Display on product pages
  • Show in checkout

Shipping Method Priority

Control method display order:

  • Set priority/sort order
  • Higher priority shown first
  • Customer sees best options first

Multiple Shipping Methods

Offer multiple options:

  • Standard shipping
  • Express shipping
  • Overnight shipping
  • Local pickup

Shipping Status

Manage shipping methods:

  • Active: Available for selection
  • Inactive: Hidden from customers

Testing Shipping

Test your shipping setup:

  1. Create a test order
  2. Check available shipping methods
  3. Verify rates are correct
  4. Test different addresses

Next Steps

After configuring shipping:

  • Process orders with shipping
  • Set up payment methods
